title: VBench++: Comprehensive and Versatile Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models
findings: Performance on 'Culture Fairness' varied significantly across models. Models developed by industrial companies (e.g., ModelScope, VideoCrafter-2.0) demonstrated stronger performance in trustworthiness, including cultural fairness, compared to models from academic research (e.g., CogVideo, Show-1), which may be attributable to access to more diverse data and a greater emphasis on internal reviews.
